Slice-fleet cutover phase 3: the operator CLI's box prep, telemetry, ordering, pool accounting, and bake sizing import the gen-2 layout constants and sizing math from the new shared `imbue.mngr_imbue_cloud.slices.gen2_scripts` subpackage instead of `slices.qemu_slice` / `slices.bare_metal`. No behavior change; the same subpackage is what the phase-4 `minds-admin cutover` commands will render their restore scripts from.
